brief: Data engineering in 2026: 6 tools that replace the old Kafka + Spark + Airflow nightmare.

slots.tagline: Replaces Airflow with visual, event-driven pipelines that deploy in minutes.
slots.f1Body: Drag nodes to build complex ETL without writing boilerplate DAG code.
slots.f2Body: React to webhooks, schedules, or database changes instantly.
slots.f3Body: Run on your own infrastructure for full data privacy and control.

slots.tagline: Postgres with realtime extensions eliminates Kafka for most streaming workloads.
slots.f1Body: Push database changes to clients without managing message brokers.
slots.f2Body: Transform and route data close to users with serverless TypeScript.
slots.f3Body: Auto-generated REST and GraphQL endpoints cut integration time.

slots.tagline: Modern Postgres extensions replace Spark SQL for petabyte-scale analytics.
slots.f1Body: Extensions like Hydra turn Postgres into a fast OLAP warehouse.
slots.f2Body: Query semi-structured event data without complex schema registries.
slots.f3Body: Leverage multiple cores to process aggregates in seconds, not hours.

slots.tagline: Redis Streams handles high-throughput events without Kafka's operational overhead.
slots.f1Body: Sub-millisecond latency for event ingestion and windowed aggregations.
slots.f2Body: Consumer groups provide exactly-once processing out of the box.
slots.f3Body: Choose snapshotting or AOF to balance speed and durability.

slots.tagline: Containerize every pipeline to replace YARN and Spark cluster management.
slots.f1Body: Package Python, SQL, and Node jobs into immutable container images.
slots.f2Body: Deploy to any cloud Kubernetes or Docker Swarm in seconds.
slots.f3Body: CPU and memory limits prevent one bad job from killing the cluster.

slots.tagline: Version control your schemas, SQL, and pipeline definitions as infrastructure.
slots.f1Body: Automate testing and deployment of dbt models and container images.
slots.f2Body: Peer review SQL transformations before they hit production warehouses.
slots.f3Body: Track every schema change and rollback bad deployments instantly.

slots.ctaBody: Drop the legacy complexity. This six-tool stack scales from prototype to production without the Kafka + Spark + Airflow headache.
